podcast.title: Geographical Origin
podcast.body: The Dayglo Abortions were a hardcore punk band from the West Coast of Canada, a region described as having fertile ground for the genre. "But the West Coast had the most fertile ground, the subhumans and day glue abortions, for example."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Prominent on Canadian West Coast
podcast.body: Dayglo Abortions were one of the important hardcore bands from the Canadian West Coast, which was described as having "the most fertile ground" for the genre. "But the West Coast had the most fertile ground, the subhumans and dayglow abortions, for example."
